text:
Alex C: Quick ask — we're lining up the v2 endpoint migration next week and I want a single spot to capture ownership gaps + canary windows. Who's taking what? (cc @Mara @Jordan @Neha)

Mara P: I can own product comms + canary criteria. Will draft the release note and the customer-facing checklist.

Jordan: I'll own SDK adapters and compatibility tests. Can we get a list of the endpoints that are changing header/param behavior?

Alex C: Good. Top-level change: `POST /v1/generate` -> `POST /v2/generate` (same payload but different header rules for streaming). Also param rename: `max_tokens` -> `token_limit` for the new SDK.

Neha S: Infra dependency: edge-proxy needs a small config bump to allow `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` passthrough; that's on eng-infra. I'll follow up with a PR but we need a canary window that doesn't overlap with nightly batch jobs.

Mara P: Proposed canary windows: daytime slice (11:00-12:30 UTC) and evening (02:00-03:00 UTC). Small traffic (1%) first, then 10% if no regressions.

Sam (deploy-bot): scheduled canary jobs created:
```
canary-1: 2024-03-18T11:00:00Z -> 2024-03-18T12:30:00Z (1%)
canary-2: 2024-03-19T02:00:00Z -> 2024-03-19T03:00:00Z (10%)
rollback-window: 30m
```

Jordan: Thanks. For PRs, ping `#eng-releases` and add `v2-migration` label. My rough PR list: `sdk-js#412`, `sdk-py#298`, `compat-tests#77`. I'll paste links in a sec.

Alex C: Please include owners in PR descriptions and add migration checklist items: `upgrade guide`, `quickstart diff`, `breaking-changes.md` entry.

Mara P: I'll add the user-facing doc updates. Also flagging that enterprise customers on Dedicated need an opt-in toggle; sales asked for a 2-week notice email.

Neha S: infra PR: https://git.internal/r/infra/edge-proxy/pulls/104 — it's small, ready for review. If merged, canary proxy behavior is good.

Jordan: SDK PRs:
- https://git.internal/r/sdk-js/pulls/412
- https://git.internal/r/sdk-py/pulls/298
- https://git.internal/r/compat-tests/pulls/77
I've added unit+smoke tests. Please review by EOD tomorrow if you can.

Alex C: Action items summary: 
- Mara: release note + customer email + docs (owner)
- Jordan: SDK PRs + tests (owner)
- Neha: infra PR + verify proxy canary (owner)
- Alex: rollout coordination + canary monitoring dashboard
- Everyone: review linked PRs and drop :eyes: reactions if okay

Mara P: I'm also going to create a short eval prompt set to catch quality regressions during canary. Posting in `eng-ml` shortly.

Sam (deploy-bot): canary-1 started (2024-03-18T11:00:00Z) :rocket:

Alex C: Thanks — please update this thread when reviews are done or if blockers pop up.

Jordan: Reviewing now, will ping when green.

Neha S: Proxy PR merged, canary network checks passing.

Mara P: Docs drafted, added to `docs/changes/v2-migration.md` and linked the release email draft.

Alex C: Great progress — moving to monitoring checklist now. If anyone spots a behavioral regression, call `#oncall` and abort canary. :thumbsup:

Jordan: LGTM on SDK PRs, leaving final approval after a small lint fix.

Alex C: Closing loop: next update in this thread with final canary status. Thanks all. :party:
